evidence_snippets: For additional protection, as of 11 July 2023, new 1.27+ clusters also have a policy rule to enforce the securityContext settings and reject Pods that use unsafe sysctls.

Autopilot This page describes the security features, configurations, and settings in Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot mode.
